install.title: Install apps
install.subtitle: Install the small apps first, then the main NBOS. Copy a URL, paste it in the phone or computer browser, and install from the browser menu — not from a banner on the site.
install.orderNote: Order matters. If the main app is installed first, the browser may refuse the others.

copy.title: Copy the URL
copy.body: Press Copy URL on the next app in the list. Start with + Task. Finish with NBOS.

paste.title: Paste in the browser
paste.body: Open Chrome or Safari on the phone or computer, paste the link, and wait for the page to open.

browser.title: Install from the browser
browser.body: Android and iPhone use different browser menus.

art.phoneAlt: Phone preview with the NBOS splash
